title: Backfill the missing v0.8.0 GitHub Release from CHANGELOG.md without moving releases/latest (OPAG-646)
description: Dispatched by opum-agent under OPAG-646, 2026-09-27 (found first by lore-web). v0.8.0 has a git tag (tag object cfd84892 -> commit 4d4a1bfb) and an npm publish (@opum-ai/lore@0.8.0, 2026-09-19T01:02:44Z) but no GitHub Release; every other release is 'Lore CLI <version>' with the CHANGELOG section as its body. This is the one-off backfill; LCLI-622 is the automation that stops the gap recurring. Kept separate from LCLI-622 because that task is held behind LCLI-621 and this one is deliverable now.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release exists for the existing tag v0.8.0, titled Lore CLI 0.8.0, whose body is the ## [0.8.0] section of CHANGELOG.md verbatim; the tag is not moved or recreated
releases/latest is still v0.11.0 after the release is created, read back by API
The release URL and the read-backs are recorded on this task

implementationNotes: Done 2026-09-27: gh release create v0.8.0 --verify-tag --title 'Lore CLI 0.8.0' --notes-file <awk-extracted ## [0.8.0] section, 162 lines> --latest=false. URL https://github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli/releases/tag/v0.8.0. Read-backs by API right after: releases/tags/v0.8.0 name 'Lore CLI 0.8.0' draft=false prerelease=false; body equals the CHANGELOG section modulo leading/trailing blank lines (cmp); releases/latest = v0.11.0 'Lore CLI 0.11.0'; ls-remote v0.8.0 still tag cfd84892 -> commit 4d4a1bfb (tag not moved). FINDING outside this task's scope: v0.6.0 is the same gap -- tag present on origin and @opum-ai/lore@0.6.0 published to npm (2026-09-09T19:26:14Z), CHANGELOG has ## [0.6.0], but no GitHub Release. Not cut here; reported to opum-agent, who enumerated the release list and did not name it.
finalSummary: Backfilled the missing v0.8.0 GitHub Release (OPAG-646): created 'Lore CLI 0.8.0' on the existing v0.8.0 tag with the CHANGELOG ## [0.8.0] section as its body, non-draft, non-prerelease, --latest=false, so releases/latest stays v0.11.0. Verified by API read-back of the release, the body against CHANGELOG, releases/latest, and the unmoved tag. https://github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli/releases/tag/v0.8.0. Found v0.6.0 has the same gap; reported, not cut. Recurrence is LCLI-622's job.
